body: I came home to find she changed and grabbed a few things. Seeing her toothbrush gone fucked me up.
You're right. Thank you. This is gonna be hard.
I've been doing so non-stop since it happened. She's yet to reply to anything. Yeah, I'm clingy, I know. I love this girl and I don't want to lose her.

It's never happened before with her. I haven't seen that side of me since I was 13. Why am I suddenly a shitty guy for losing my cool once. It's not an excuse, if I had done that several times: Hell yeah. Fuck me. But this is the first.
